manual.reason: Button properties are response-only in the Notion API: the schema is returned on read, but the API ignores button settings on write and cannot create a button or configure its actions.

manual.title: Three recurring templates
manual.reason: Recurring database templates (daily/weekly/monthly) are configured in the app on the template's ••• menu; the API can create pages from a template but cannot schedule recurrence.
